descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Step into a transformative role with us as an Disease Area Partner, where you will be at the heart of the evolving landscape of healthcare. Driven by groundbreaking innovation, greater patient empowerment, and the expanding wealth of medical information, our ecosystem is adapting to new challenges and heightened demands on public resources. As an Disease Area Partner, you will work locally, deeply integrated within the healthcare community, focusing exclusively on building meaningful stakeholder relationships without the constraints of sales targets or incentives. This allows you to focus entirely on delivering impactful, needs-based support for patients and healthcare providers. Your Impact
• Steward Roche’s products through their lifecycle and support their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner
• Implement campaigns with customers and distribute promotional materials as per marketing plan and customer needs
• Organize group meetings in major hospitals
• Propose new ideas related to campaigns, promotional material to the pod and are responsible for the implementation after approval.
• Gathering Data & Insights from the market that would help the pod to make decisions.
• The DA partner focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
• Identifies important customers and keeps customer Personas up-to-date.
• Continuously revises and updates the customer list & no. of patients in cooperation with the pod.
• Positively participates in Internal meetings to review and discuss: achievements, Opportunities/challenges, Competitors activities.
• Reporting Adverse Events to the Local Safety Unite within Roche timelines.
• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. Who you are
• You bring 1-2 years of experience within the pharmaceutical industry.
• You have good business acumen, with desired experience in commercialization, medical, and customer experience excellence, and can leverage digital tools effectively
• You demonstrate a personal commitment to improving the patient journey, with a strong drive to create value and impact on the ecosystem
• You embody a strategic vision to enhance patient journeys and embed this within your actions
• You possess an entrepreneurial mindset, continuously seeking opportunities to innovate and contribute
• You maintain a growth mindset, learning and unlearning rapidly, experimenting, and sharing insights within and beyond Roche
• You display integrity in every action, upholding honesty, ethics, and authenticity
• You bring excellent stakeholder engagement skills, effectively partnering with therapeutic area experts (TAEs), organizations, and ideally with patient advocacy groups (PAGs)
• You are fluent in the local language and proficient in English, facilitating collaboration across Roche’s broader enterprise. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empo
